Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human FLT3. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id and docs on compound_records.doc_id for provenance. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
